# 1.2.4
## Added
- Added waypoint support when compass is in bundle (resolves [#9](https://github.com/FuzjaJadrowa/LocatorBar/issues/9) issue).
- [26.1.2] Added LTS support for 26.1.2 mod version.
- [26.3] Added support for 26.3 version.
## Changed
- [26.3 Neoforge] Changed deprecated `logoFile` to `iconFile` in manifest.
## Fixed
- Refactored some large piece of code which might fix some bugs with config.
- Fixed waypoint not hiding when compass dropped by Q key (resolves [#8](https://github.com/FuzjaJadrowa/LocatorBar/issues/8) issue).

releases.notes:
# 1.2.2
## Added
- Added drop shadow to coordinate and day counters under reworked locator bar.
- Added `/locatorbar` command for changing server-side options of the config or seeing help with some entries.
## Changed
- Changed the experience bar visible duration when collecting XP to 5 seconds.
- [1.21.4] Ended support for 1.21.4. Shows specified modal for users of these versions.
- Changed server config format from TOML to JSON. Options should be migrated.
- Simplified locator bar dots. Now uses only one texture.
## Fixed
- [26.2, 1.21.11] Fixed the experience level number remaining visible when the experience bar is hidden.
- [1.21.4, 1.21.1] Fixed locator bar elements displaying under the experience bar and level number.
- Fixed some other bugs and memory leaks.

releases.notes:
# 1.2.0
Player marker customization and new translations. It's recommended to refresh config files.
## Added
- Added option to change locator bar player marker style to dot, which change textures of this marker to 3 new ones. This system is currently in beta so report any bugs using GitHub Issues.
- Added config version entry to TOML and JSON config for a better update system.
- Added pl_pl translation by Fuzja Jądrowa.
- Added pt_br translation by guigiffoni.
## Changed
- Changed some entry names in config.
- Changed default player marker disappear value to inf.

releases.notes:
# 1.1.2
Death waypoint implementation and more customizable offset of locator bar.
## Added
- Added death waypoint that shows when a player has a Recovery Compass in inventory. Togglable in settings.
- Added X and Y offset sliders for more customizable position config (resolves [#5](https://github.com/FuzjaJadrowa/LocatorBar/issues/5) issue).
- [1.20.1, 26.2.x] Added support for 26.2 and 1.20.1 versions.
## Changed
- Removed button "Locator Bar Offset" for Reworked style config.
